note: Nebraska Game and Parks SRA just off I-80 near Sutherland, on a 3,000-acre reservoir. Three camping areas: Outlet (NE, by the canal outlet), Inlet (SW) and Westshore (W, off Hwy 25); 22 Electric Plus sites plus 100+ primitive sites on the east and west shores, gravel pads for RVs and some tent sites on sand by the water. Drought can leave the lake low. --Claude
summary: Still NGPC (Active SRA, on the 2025 grid). Confirmed FCFS year-round iron ranger, water and vault restrooms (Aug 2026 capture); season year_round added. Fees left. Waterfront not waterfront kept with a lead upward. SPLIT candidate: Inlet/Westshore (west) vs Outlet (east), ~4.3 km apart. Sand: packed gravel pads and sand tracks under trees, no open-beach driving seen.
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE: NGPC's map shows three camping areas. Outlet Area is at the NE canal outlet, where our pin sits (Google 'Sutherland Reservoir Campgrounds' 41.10302,-101.10259, 4.2 from 45). Inlet Area is at the SW inlet (Google 'Inlet Campground' 41.09194,-101.15745, 4.3 from 18) with the Westshore Area along the west shore north of it. West and east are ~4.3 km apart across the lake, on separate access roads. NGPC doesn't say which area holds the 22 Electric Plus sites, so a split would need the area-by-area counts; Google reviews say 'many of them are electric'. This entry currently stands for the whole SRA from the east pin.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept, with a LEAD UPWARD (operator claim): NGPC captions a photo 'Tent camping on the sandy beach of Sutherland Reservoir', and a Google reviewer's tent site at the inlet had 'a rock circle on the sandy beach by the water'. At the Outlet Area the stored evidence holds: loops among trees behind the shore road. The Inlet and Westshore primitive sites sit along tracks behind a tree belt, with shore clearings that may be on-water for some sites, but they can't be resolved under canopy and a tent-site claim doesn't make an RV site on-water. If the area is split, judge the west entry on its own; a lakeview for the Outlet loops is plausible through the trees, but no site photos confirm it.

SAND (AWH 2026-11-05 clarification): no bare open-beach camping found for RVs. The Outlet Area has gravel roads and gravel pads ('The gravel pads are nice for campers', Google review); Inlet sites are packed-sand clearings under trees on a maintained track. NGPC's 'sandy beach' is tent camping. No drop.

PIN: stored 41.10208,-101.10814 is on a shore loop in the Outlet Area, ~480 m W of Google's 'Sutherland Reservoir Campgrounds' point (41.10302,-101.10259, east of the highway by the outlet canal). It is inside the camping area; under-threshold nudge only, not moved.
PHONE 308-535-8025 confirmed (NGPC page and 2025 grid, Google).
